Use case: precise-object-edit.
Deliverable: a wide 16:9 portfolio world-map IMAGE PREVIEW, one of three paired ABOUT/SKILLS architectural proposals.
Edit target: supplied world image. User SELECTED the large folded-roof PROJECTS exhibition pavilion at upper right. Change ONLY the buildings, main structural landmarks, and immediately connected planting/water features on ABOUT (upper left) and SKILLS (lower left). The new structures should feel like mysterious but inhabited fantasy-adventure destinations, each with a clearly different function. Inspiration: terrain-integrated ancient spaces and practical mechanisms in exploration/crafting game worlds; create ORIGINAL architecture, no copied game temples, characters, emblems, weapons or user interfaces.
Maintain the reference's improved restrained palette: warm neutral pale stone, sage/moss-green foliage, blue-grey shadow, subdued dusty spring pink only on About, natural summer green on Skills, water blue-green. Stone/wood/metal are MATTE with only small plausible highlights. No gold outlining, orange daytime lamp glow, neon cyan crystals, glowing portals, intense saturation, plastic toy surfaces, excessive tiny details or shiny leaves. Use broad recognizable shapes and limited fine detail concentrated on the main entry or mechanism. This should feel art-directed and structurally coherent rather than a pile of fantasy props.
Architecture must be fully visible and not overlap captions or neighboring islands. No extra top-level islands, NPCs, pets, invented achievements, or game HUD. Do not add new text or labels. Personal portfolio purpose: About represents the owner's story and values; Skills represents the process of designing/building with tools. The structures are metaphors, not assertions about the owner's personal hobbies. Only selected stone desks/shelves/worktables are needed to communicate purpose.
SPECIFIC PAIRED PROPOSAL:
PAIR 01 — ANCIENT ROOT ARCHIVE + HYDRAULIC MAKER SANCTUARY.
ABOUT: preserve a tall broad living spring tree as the dominant organic silhouette, but replace the entire cabin with a LOW CIRCULAR PALE-STONE ARCHIVE nestled among its massive exposed roots. A large open round stone doorway and one curved stone wall are embraced by the old root arch. Visible through the open entry: a quiet curved wall of a few book shelves, a simple writing table and a shallow circular skylight. The roots are living natural wood, NOT timber construction. No timber roof, porch or cottage. Heavy stone steps curve through the tree roots toward the entrance. Subtle dusty-blush blossoms mixed with green leaves in broad canopy groups. A thin spring emerges beside the root and follows shallow stone basins down one edge. Shape: organic spreading tree + intimate circular stone chamber, clearly fantasy and clearly a place of personal records.
SKILLS: completely replace the roofed workshop with an OPEN ANCIENT STONE WATERWORKS / MAKER COURT. Two substantial offset stone pylons support an elevated aqueduct. One LARGE weathered dark-bronze vertical waterwheel/ring turbine on the outer left, visibly connected to a stone channel and axle, powers a broad circular worktable on a lower terrace through a short exposed shaft and a few readable gears. Three simple tool stations around the table suggest drafting, building and testing; no tiny branded logos or weapons. At the back, one incomplete curved stone support arch and broad low wall establish ruin architecture without a building roof. Practical water source, sluice, wheel, channel and two distinct short cascades make the mechanism believable. Large clean silhouette: asymmetric stone pylons and wheel against the sky. Summer green plants occupy the margins only. Use sparse machinery, no dense steampunk pipes. This pair emphasizes nature/records on About and purposeful working machinery on Skills.
outputs.proposedAmbient: About: leaves/petals and spring. Skills: sluice, wheel and restrained coupled shaft movement.

SPECIFIC PAIRED PROPOSAL:
PAIR 02 — SKY OBSERVATORY ARCHIVE + ANCIENT ASSEMBLY ENGINE.
ABOUT: replace the cabin AND dominant tree mass with a rounded, compact PALE-STONE OBSERVATORY ARCHIVE, one low broad dome of matte weathered grey-green copper with a clean OPEN observation slit. A restrained telescope projects from the slit, one spiral terrace wraps the rotunda, and a wide open arched doorway reveals a reading desk and wall niches. The structure is substantially wider than tall, never a second lighthouse. A small quiet dusty-pink flowering tree is off to the side, not covering the dome. Narrow spring channels trace the curved entry stair. No royal turrets, pointed castle roofs, ornate gold astrolabes, timber cottage or huge glowing moon. Shape: a single clear hemispherical dome with an open slit, personal study and outlook.
SKILLS: create a bold roofless ASSEMBLY DEVICE framed between TWO OFFSET TALL RECTANGULAR STONE MONOLITHS. A large mechanically suspended dark bronze gyroscope of two crossing rings holds a plain geometric stone workpiece directly above a circular assembly platform. Connect the rings physically by axles and bearings to the monoliths; no free-floating magic sphere, neon energy core or sci-fi portal. Three broad stepped work platforms connect through short sturdy stone bridges at different levels within this ONE island. Sparse drafting tables, tool racks and pulleys communicate making and adjustment. A water channel descends down the shorter monolith into a split cascade at the island edge. Summer grasses and a few grey-green trees frame, not hide, the structure. Shape: two upright slab pillars + a large suspended ring mechanism, distinct from About's dome and Projects' long folded roof. Readable, restrained and monumental, no industrial factory shed.
outputs.proposedAmbient: About: slow telescope/dome adjustment. Skills: independently paced rings around a supported workpiece.

SPECIFIC PAIRED PROPOSAL:
PAIR 03 — CLIFFSIDE CRESCENT LIBRARY + WIND-POWERED DESIGN WORKS.
ABOUT: remove the cottage AND huge flowering tree. Carve a WIDE CRESCENT-SHAPED STONE LIBRARY into the upper cliff ridge, with an open semicircular reading court and exactly three large arched openings into deep book niches. A grass-covered curved roof follows the rock contour, with only one small soft-pink flowering tree on its far edge. Broad curved stone steps descend toward the entry terrace; a slim spring falls through a narrow rock slit alongside the library. A single plain reading desk in the court indicates a personal archive. Architecture is low, carved and horizontal; no wooden roof, village facade, overgrown wall carpet or tiny repeating columns. Shape: a deliberate half-circle cut into rock with large calm masonry surfaces.
SKILLS: replace the workshop with a WIND-POWERED MAKER PLATFORM: one large VERTICAL-AXIS HELICAL WIND ROTOR of four curved matte ivory sail blades around an exposed bronze shaft, mounted on a stepped stone plinth. The blades are sculptural like a slowly turning ancient mechanical sail device, not a European village windmill and not a neon orb. A short exposed gear train drives a round adjustable drafting/assembly table on a neighboring lower terrace. Two broken stone fin-like buttresses and one broad open canopyless stone workbench anchor the device, tools are few and large. A long curved water channel skirts the terrace and splits into two fine falls. Summer sage/green planting kept low so the helix silhouette is clear. Keep the rotor no taller than the original Skills island's available footprint so it stays secondary to Projects. Shape: tall sculptural helical blades over asymmetric stepped working terraces. No timber shed, mast flags, steam clouds or machinery clutter.
outputs.proposedAmbient: About: spring water and page/foliage response. Skills: wind rotor, exposed gear and water channels.
